instruction:
Inspect up to the 10 most recent substantive proposals in #feedback-and-ideas. For each, report the author, timestamp, concise proposal, visible reaction count, visible
    reply count, and any explicitly stated benefit or concern from its thread. Rank the 3 proposals with the highest combined visible reactions and replies, preserving chronological
    order for ties. If fewer proposals exist, analyze all available. Do not send, edit, delete, react to, or otherwise modify any Slack content.
